provisions.heading: ANNEX XLI
provisions.subtitle: Allocation of financial contribution to spending instruments

items.b: (a) Ukraine Facility, established by Regulation (EU) 2024/792 of the European Parliament and of the Council: 100 %;

(b) Union programmes supporting cooperation for common procurement of additional quantities for Ukraine and aiming at the recovery, reconstruction and modernisation of the Ukraine Defence Technological and Industrial Base: 0 %.

items.r: 1.
